baseline.damage_note: No contact implies modeled zero damage. Contact energy and native damage are not simulated.

settings.note: No native run, debris truth or native damage-energy estimate used.

all_failure_events.note: Statistics of event-wise percentiles, with repeated correlated observations; not a pooled debris percentile.

pre_diagnostic_comparison.score_precision_note: Legacy scores are rounded to 0.01; promotion also requires a positive lower bound after allowing 0.01 for median-difference rounding.
pre_diagnostic_comparison.caveat: Paired bootstrap uses clean arrival pairs only and excludes systematic simulator-model error. Incomplete runs are reported separately; a harness timeout is not an official competition disqualification.

interpretation: Nominal radar-center spread is not the minimum bypass offset, occupied volume, or proof that no internal gap exists. Inflation, motion and time-aware clearance are not included in these percentiles.
